headline: Premier Limited holds its Annual General Meeting
hook: Routine shareholder meeting concluded at Premier
summary: Premier Limited has formally submitted the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Such procedural filings are standard regulatory compliance for listed companies at the close of the financial period. Indian retail investors holding shares in Premier Limited need to track official disclosures for any special resolutions passed during the meet.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
